decisions.reason: Adding door, sink, and shower dimensions as plan annotations does not change the Unit 3 bathroom fixture locations or spatial layout.
The source requests fixture dimensions on the plan but does not require them on the separate furnished-layout drawing or alter its contents.
The later request for dimension annotations does not change the required content or purpose of the initial concept sketch.
Annotating fixture dimensions does not modify any fixture or door location in the Unit 1 ensuite bathroom.
The annotation request leaves the Unit 1 common-bathroom configuration and fixture locations unchanged.
Showing door, sink, and shower dimensions does not change the Unit 2 bathroom layout or centered door position.
The source adds dimension labels but does not alter the Unit 3 bathroom door position or its kitchen-counter clearance constraint.
Bathroom fixture dimension annotations do not change the Unit 3 kitchen arrangement or bathroom-door clearance requirement.
The source concerns displaying fixture dimensions and does not change bathroom drainage locations, connections, or alignment constraints.
Adding bathroom fixture dimensions to the plan does not change any partition-wall construction, demolition, or preservation rule.
The referenced bathroom door dimension is an annotation request and does not modify common or independent entrance-door arrangements.
Bathroom fixture dimension annotations are unrelated to whether the balcony remains open or is incorporated into an adjacent room.
